text: Currency Transaction Report (CTR): financial institutions must file a CTR for any cash transaction exceeding 10,000 USD in a single business day, aggregating multiple transactions by the same customer.
Know Your Customer (KYC) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD): verify and record customer identity before onboarding, and assess the money-laundering risk of the business relationship.
Suspicious Activity Report (SAR): file a SAR when a transaction has no apparent lawful or economic purpose, or is inconsistent with the customer's known legitimate activity.
Politically Exposed Persons (PEP): apply enhanced due diligence to PEPs, including senior management approval, source-of-wealth checks, and ongoing enhanced monitoring.
Structuring: a customer splits large cash deposits into smaller amounts across days or branches to evade the currency transaction reporting threshold.
Shell company wire: an outbound wire transfer sent to a shell company registered in a high-risk jurisdiction with no clear business rationale.
